notes:
## New features
- Google map imports in Great Britain use OSGB36 National Grid placement, with matching real-world coordinates on sheet neatlines. New projects remain local until georeferenced imagery is imported.
- Sheet legends support adjustable swatch size and corner rounding, subtle colour glow and drop shadows. A separate map-to-sidebar divider has configurable colour and thickness.
- Portable project packages keep imported map images and original documents together, so projects can be moved and reopened without missing assets.
- A compact model-health indicator shows warning and error counts, with gentle feedback when new issues appear.
- A cyan title-bar update control shows availability, background download progress and when an update is ready to install.

## Changes
- Sheet settings follow the page structure, using the same flat section headings and filled controls as the Project panel.
- Reduced coordinate-neatline margins to give the map more room.
- Improved dense-scene contour performance through cached geometry and parallel evaluation while retaining exact building-edge support checks.
- Redesigned map import and autosave recovery windows make the next step clearer.
- Refined typography, toolbar icons, menus and spacing throughout the main workspaces.
- Reorganised project details with an expandable description and a single New, Open and Save row. New projects automatically use your organisation defaults.
- Refreshed the project browser with clearer search, project previews and scenario controls.
- Rebuilt the contour inspector with shared tab navigation, compact level and appearance controls, clearer sheet settings and grouped optional typography controls.
- Project descriptions now show three lines by default and keep their filled background while editing.
- Added a little breathing room above the toolbar in full screen.
- Matched Editor toolbar dropdown heights to the compact Time Slice and Scenario controls.
- Update notices group release information into features, changes and fixes, with a distinct cyan appearance.

## Bug fixes
- Rebuilt the level-band scrolling area so the upper and lower range controls cannot overlap editable rows.
- Legend rows now account for swatch height and effects, preventing tall shapes from colliding.
- Corrected the 3D viewport position so it stays below the toolbar when switching workspaces.
- Smoothed the 3D viewport’s rounded corners on macOS.
- Fixed menu sizing that could leave excess space or make the final item difficult to select.
- Removed application-wide event handling implicated in the map browser crash path.
- Centred update progress across the full window, including when the restart action is visible.
- Removed duplicate headings from Inputs and Results and unnecessary steps during PDF map import.
- Fixed dropdown click-to-open behaviour and selection notifications; lists can extend beyond the main window while staying within the screen.
- Removed the About splash outline while retaining a soft shadow and smooth rounded corners.
- Avoided redundant acoustic path searches when an exact search has already established that no route exists.
